about_the_game:
This is a 3D fantasy tower defense game centered on core gameplay mechanics including hero control, elemental reactions, equipment drops, exclusive weapon drops, and strategic tower defense.

In an era where elements run amok and disasters strike frequently, you will assemble a team of heroes, each mastering powers of different elements, set up defensive lines, and fend off the powerful, vicious, and cruel enemies that plague this planet.

Nine Elements, Hundreds of Combinations

Freely mix and match nine elements—Fire, Water, Thunder, Ice, Wind, Earth, Light, Dark, and Wood. Trigger chain effects such as Overload, Swirl, Vaporize, Freeze, Electro-Charged, Melt, Aggravate, Bloom, Burning, and Annihilation through elemental reactions, and experience both strategic depth and visual spectacle.

Over Twenty Playable Heroes

Each hero possesses three unique abilities: Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst. During battles, these abilities can be upgraded into more powerful and visually stunning versions, offering diverse growth paths and build options. Take real-time control on the battlefield, decide the timing of skill activation, and turn the tide of the battle.

Farm for Equipment and Exclusive Weapons

Challenge bosses and clear levels to obtain rare equipment, and customize your damage playstyle. Want to stack Attack? Elemental Mastery? Critical Hit? Elemental Damage Boost? Elemental Energy Recharge? The choice is entirely yours.

Strategy Meets Action

Enjoy a 3D free camera perspective, where combat and defense setup blend seamlessly. Multiple enemy paths, multi-boss invasions, and random monsters ensure every tower defense match feels fresh and thrilling.
